title: The Girl With the Scarf
summary: The stranger in the canoe reaches the dock, and the lake has to do some work.

beats.text: Day four. The canoe bumped our dock at first light.
The scarf belonged to a girl of about ten. She shook so hard the paddle rattled.
Her name was Pip. Ava wrapped her in a blanket and said nothing sarcastic.
Then I heard dragging feet in the pines. The dozen had followed her trail.

beats.speaker: ava
beats.text: "They can't swim," Ava whispered. I had an idea, and I hated it.
I stood at the end of the dock and banged a pot with a spoon.
They turned toward the noise, and walked into the cold water.
The lake closed over them. Ripples, and then nothing.
But they were still walking down there, along the bottom.
Pip finally spoke. "Please," she said. "My brother is still on the island."
